messages.noConnection: I currently have no connection to the system. I cannot know the current temperature or humidity. Once the connection returns, I will be able to analyze the measurements.
messages.loading: I am still waiting for the sensor data. I do not have a real measurement to analyze yet.
messages.noData: I do not have real sensor data yet. I don't want to make up a temperature or humidity value that I don't know. Once the measurements arrive, I will be able to analyze them.
messages.noDataShort: I do not have real sensor data yet. Once the system sends a valid measurement, I will be able to help you interpret it.
messages.start: Hello! I'm Balthazar, your environmental panel assistant. I can help you interpret temperature, humidity, and sensor behavior.
messages.measurements: We currently have a temperature of {{temperature}} °C and {{humidity}}% humidity. Let's see what these values mean.

temperature.low: The current temperature is {{temperature}} °C. It is relatively low, so the environment is cool.
temperature.normal: The current temperature is {{temperature}} °C. It is within a fairly comfortable range for an indoor environment.
temperature.warm: The current temperature is {{temperature}} °C. The environment is starting to feel quite warm. It is worth monitoring the trend.
temperature.high: We have {{temperature}} °C. That's getting quite hot! It would be advisable to check the environmental conditions.

humidity.low: Humidity is at {{humidity}}%. It is relatively low, so the environment may feel dry.
humidity.normal: Current humidity is {{humidity}}%. It is within a fairly balanced range.
humidity.high: Humidity is at {{humidity}}%. It is somewhat high, although it does not necessarily represent a problem yet.
humidity.veryHigh: Humidity is at {{humidity}}%. It is quite high, so it is worth monitoring the environment and its evolution.

history.none: I don't have historical records available yet.
history.one: I have one record, but I need at least two measurements to compare the environmental evolution.
history.many: I have {{count}} historical records. With them, I can observe how temperature and humidity have changed over time.

trend.notEnough: I need at least two measurements to determine a trend.
trend.invalid: I have historical records, but I cannot correctly identify the temperature in them.
trend.increasing: The latest measurement shows that the temperature is increasing compared to the previous record.
trend.decreasing: The latest measurement shows that the temperature is decreasing compared to the previous record.
trend.stable: The temperature remains practically stable between the latest measurements.

messages.connection: The panel is connected to the system and can receive sensor measurements.

advice.bothHigh: The combination of temperature and humidity is quite high. It is advisable to monitor the environment and maintain good ventilation.
advice.bothLow: The environment is cool and relatively dry. You can observe whether these conditions remain stable in the following measurements.
advice.humidityHigh: Humidity is high. I recommend observing its evolution in the historical chart.
advice.temperatureHigh: The temperature is high. It is best to monitor the following measurements.
advice.stable: The current conditions appear relatively stable. You can check the history to see if there is any trend.

messages.default: I'm here to help you interpret the behavior of the environmental panel.
